label: In any frame of the Scott-style constant-domain embedding, if the generating atom has the same…
paraphrase: In any frame of the Scott-style constant-domain embedding, if the generating atom has the same Boolean value for a particular bearer in every world, that bearer satisfies the Boolean-fragment-filtered necessary-existence predicate at every world. This holds even if the primitive varies for other bearers, and does not establish metaphysical necessity or existence.
